title: poa alpigena subsp. colpodea
intro: Poa alpigena subsp. colpodea, commonly known as Alpine Timothy, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to high-altitude regions of the Himalayas and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Poa alpigena subsp. colpodea include its ability to lower inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide relief from oxidative stress and inflammation.
